description: Fork a saved build into a new autosaved draft. Use this instead of editing the existing build when the user wants a variant and the original must stay intact. The fork copies the uploader configuration and media references, receives a new build ID, and can be edited independently. Confirm that the fork was created; share its URL only when the user asks for it or says there is no open uploader tab. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd with no campaign or adSet creates a new paused campaign and ad set from the template settings. Cross-campaign create/preview is available only for direct agent requests. Saved builds and Agent Inbox launches must use the template ad's campaign or a new campaign; to save a build for another existing campaign, copy from an ad in that campaign (campaign.id + adSet.id picks one). Existing stored cross-campaign builds can still launch, but cannot be re-saved. The same goes for ad sets: a saved build that names an existing ad set must name the template ad's own ad set, or use a new ad set; to post into another existing ad set, copy from an ad in that ad set or launch directly without saving a build. A stored build that names another ad set can still launch from the CLI and MCP, but must be changed in the uploader before it launches there.
